# aggregate.process_single_sidecar { #healpyxel.aggregate.process_single_sidecar }

```python
aggregate.process_single_sidecar(
    input_file,
    sidecar_path,
    sidecar_metadata_json,
    sidecars_df,
    sidecar_index,
    args,
    use_duckdb,
)
```

Process a single sidecar file through the full aggregation workflow.

This function orchestrates one sidecar through the complete aggregation
pipeline: load data, merge with sidecar, compute aggregations,
optionally densify, and write output with metadata.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                  | Type               | Description                                                                                 | Default    |
|-----------------------|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| input_file            | Path               | Original input parquet file.                                                                | _required_ |
| sidecar_path          | Path               | Path to sidecar parquet file.                                                               | _required_ |
| sidecar_metadata_json | dict               | Loaded metadata from ``.meta.json`` companion file.                                         | _required_ |
| sidecars_df           | pd.DataFrame       | DataFrame collected by :func:`collect_sidecar_outputs` with all available sidecar metadata. | _required_ |
| sidecar_index         | int                | Index of this sidecar in ``sidecars_df``.                                                   | _required_ |
| args                  | argparse.Namespace | Parsed command-line arguments controlling aggregation behavior.                             | _required_ |
| use_duckdb            | bool               | Whether DuckDB is available and enabled for data loading.                                   | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                             |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Processing summary with keys: ``status`` (``'success'``, ``'skip'``, ``'error'``), ``output_path``, ``metadata_path``, ``n_cells``, ``error`` (if any). |
